fields.description:
## Context and measured baseline

The real-artifact oracle from closed ticket ducal-statuelike-ladybird is valuable, but tests/unit/test_build_provenance.py independently runs git archive plus python -m build in four tests. On the current macOS host the unchanged module took 35.93s. Individually: install-from-sdist 8.40s, wheel-from-sdist 4.69s, sdist-content 4.53s, and empty-env failure 1.81s. Three tests repeat the identical successful clean-tree build with REBAR_BUILD_COMMIT=abc1234; install-from-sdist then performs a distinct second wheel build from the produced sdist.

## OSS consensus and prior decisions

Setuptools builds stable sdist/wheel artifacts once under a session lock and exposes session-scoped readonly fixtures (pypa/setuptools@7d53128, setuptools/tests/fixtures.py#L70-L130). PyPA Build builds a dependency wheel once in a session fixture for downstream tests (pypa/build@bf222f4, tests/test_projectbuilder.py#L427-L438). Closed ticket ducal-statuelike-ladybird requires the real wheel/sdist boundaries but does not require rebuilding an identical prerequisite per assertion. No rejection exists.

## Plan

1. Change only tests/unit/test_build_provenance.py. Create one pytest session-scoped fixture per xdist worker using tmp_path_factory. It performs one git archive of HEAD and one real python -m build with REBAR_BUILD_COMMIT=abc1234.
2. Return only immutable artifact paths from that fixture: the built wheel and sdist. Consumers inspect these archives read-only. No consumer receives the shared extracted source or output directory, preventing mutation of shared state.
3. Wheel-from-sdist and sdist-content tests reuse the corresponding real shared artifacts while retaining their exact archive-content assertions.
4. Install-from-sdist copies/extracts the shared sdist into its function-scoped tmp_path, then performs the distinct real env-unset rebuild there. Empty-env failure keeps its own function-scoped clean tree and real failing build because its environment and observable boundary differ.
5. Strengthen the existing test module with deterministic build-call counting under a subprocess seam or equivalent fixture-level contract: one successful prerequisite build per pytest worker/session plus the retained empty-env and rebuild-from-sdist calls. Timing remains evidence, never a pass threshold.
6. RED first against the current per-test rebuild behavior; hold the counter oracle out from the fixture refactor. GREEN, then seed both defects independently: restore a duplicate successful build and remove/corrupt COMMIT in the shared artifact. The counter/provenance oracles must return RED.
7. Re-run the module serially and with xdist, report individual and total before/after durations, then run lint, typecheck, and the default pytest selection.

## Test contract card

authoritative_contract: ducal-statuelike-ladybird and tests/unit/test_build_provenance.py require real wheel-from-sdist provenance, empty-env build failure, sdist build-info content, and env-unset rebuild-from-sdist preservation.
trigger_preconditions: a clean git archive without .git and REBAR_BUILD_COMMIT=abc1234; separate empty env and env-unset rebuild cases.
production_path: python -m build through hatch_build.py, with real wheel/sdist archive inspection.
test_tier: real subprocess/package builds; a unit tier cannot prove artifact contents or the sdist-to-wheel boundary.
observable_postcondition: identical provenance/failure/content assertions; exactly one identical successful prerequisite build per worker/session, while empty-env failure and rebuild-from-sdist remain distinct real builds.
negative_control: empty-env failure does not consume the successful artifact; rebuild operates on a function-local extraction and cannot mutate shared inputs.
collateral_invariants: fixture lifetime ends with the pytest session; xdist workers share nothing; no cross-session/on-disk cache; no production file changes.
ci_gate: default pytest job and full Gerrit Verified gate.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every existing real wheel/sdist assertion remains and still executes the relevant build boundary.
- [ ] One successful clean-source prerequisite build is performed per pytest worker/session; identical prerequisite archive/build work is not repeated per test.
- [ ] Shared consumers receive only read-only artifact paths; mutating extraction/rebuild work occurs in function-scoped copies.
- [ ] A defect-seeded duplicate prerequisite build fails the deterministic call-count oracle, and a defect-seeded missing COMMIT still fails the provenance oracle.
- [ ] Serial and xdist runs pass and report before/after individual durations; timing is evidence, never a gate.
- [ ] Packaging tests remain hermetic, add no cross-session cache, and lint/typecheck/default pytest/Gerrit gates pass.
